questions.question: What was the statewide observed mortality rate for coronary artery bypass graft (CABG) surgery in 2019?
questions.program:
import pandas as pd

df = pd.read_csv('nydoh_cardiac_surgery_pci_by_hospital.csv')
row = df[(df['Hospital Name'] == 'NYS - All Hospitals') & (df['Procedure'] == 'CABG') & (df['Year of Hospital Discharge'] == '2019')]
result = float(row['Observed Mortality Rate'].iloc[0])

questions.question: Between Mount Sinai Hospital and NYP-Weill Cornell, which facility performed more valve or valve/CABG procedures during the 2013–2015 discharge period?
questions.program:
import pandas as pd

df = pd.read_csv('nydoh_cardiac_surgery_pci_by_hospital.csv')
sub = df[(df['Hospital Name'].isin(['Mount Sinai Hospital', 'NYP-Weill Cornell'])) & (df['Procedure'] == 'Valve or Valve/CABG') & (df['Year of Hospital Discharge'] == '2013-2015')]
result = str(sub.sort_values(by='Number of Cases', ascending=False)['Hospital Name'].iloc[0])

questions.question: How many hospital entries in the dataset received a performance rating significantly lower than the statewide mortality rate?
questions.program:

questions.question: Which broad region accounts for the single highest number of entries in the cardiac surgery and PCI dataset?
questions.program:
import pandas as pd

df = pd.read_csv('nydoh_cardiac_surgery_pci_by_hospital.csv')
result = str(df.groupby('Region').size().idxmax())

questions.question: Did Staten Island University Hospital record zero patient deaths for TAVR procedures during the 2017–2019 discharge window?
questions.program:
